note: Rewritten from the English Diagnosis of the 9th species entry in ZSI Technical Monograph No. 4, covering the alate and the soldier; the original does not describe the worker. Type locality Kumaon Hills, Uttar Pradesh, India; host records are dead branches of mango, Celtis australis, Rhododendron arboreum and sal (Shorea robusta), not included in the body text. In the original, Length with wings c 7-8, without wings c 4.4-5.4 mm, the c stands for circa and has been rendered as about.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule and upper body chestnut brown, sternites paler. Head capsule nearly circular, its width (0.90—0.97 mm) nearly equal to the head length (to the mandible base, 0.90—0.97 mm); coronal suture distinct; compound eyes small, nearly circular, 0.23—0.25 mm in diameter; ocelli oval, usually touching the compound eye, sometimes slightly separated; antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2; pronotum nearly rectangular, narrower than the head including the compound eyes, anterior margin weakly concave, posterior margin nearly straight; wings dark brown, tuberculate. Measurements: body length including the wings about 7—8 mm, body length without the wings about 4.4—5.4 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown; body pale yellowish brown, the tergite of the last abdominal segment darker. Head capsule nearly rectangular, its length (1.43—1.73 mm) about 1.5 times the width (1.07—1.13 mm); coronal suture faint; lateral frontal protuberances weak; eye spots oval, small, flush with the head surface; labrum broadly ligulate; mandibles short and stout, shorter than half the head length (without the mandibles), the left mandible with 3 and the right mandible with 2 marginal teeth; postmentum long, clavate, slightly shorter than half the head length (without the mandibles); pronotum nearly rectangular, slightly narrower than the head to as wide as the head, anterior margin concave, faintly notched in the middle, posterior margin nearly straight. Measurements: total body length about 4.8—5.7 mm.
